text:
maria-sec: Heads-up — vendor confirmed retest window next Tue 09:00-17:00 PT. Need final checklist: RBAC for assessors, KMS access path, and sample log exports.
jordan-eng: thanks. can we scope to staging + dedicated-kms proxy? production not in scope this time.
sam-sre: staging + dedicated-kms proxy works. will need IAM role creation and ephemeral cred window. who owns role naming?
maria-sec: @sam-sre you own role provisioning. name pattern: `pentest_assessor_<vendor>_<date>`. TTL = 6h.
olivia-gc: note: legal asked for 90-day retention on exported evidence bundles. confirm S3 bucket lifecycle and ACLs.
maria-sec: yes 90 days. retention policy must prevent accidental deletes until then (object-lock or governance).
pentest-assessor: quick question from the test team — do you provide access to raw CloudTrail + VPC flow logs or filtered exports? we prefer full so we can sample.
jordan-eng: we'll provide filtered exports first pass (auth, kms calls, control plane) + full on-demand if we see gaps. need to sync cost.
sam-sre: plan: create cross-account role in infra account with `sts:AssumeRole` + restrict to `s3:GetObject`, `logs:Get*`, `cloudtrail:LookupEvents`. will also enable CloudTrail multi-region read via role.
maria-sec: KMS: vendor needs decrypt for evidence artifacts. we will *not* grant direct KMS Decrypt. instead use a KMS proxy service that mints short-lived data keys for the assessor job.
jordan-eng: implementing proxy. endpoint will be internal (VPC) with auth via ephemeral session tokens from the role. vendor will hit the proxy -> proxy calls KMS.
pentest-assessor: ok that model works. need a sample curl for evidence retrieval and a sample signature to validate.
sam-sre: sample S3 cp + proxy header:```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2026-03-xx/artifact.tar.gz .
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROXY_TOKEN" https://kms-proxy.internal.redwood/evidence/2026-03-xx/decrypt
```
olivia-gc: also require audit log of who requested decrypts. proxy must log principal + request id + object key to CloudWatch / exported log.
maria-sec: agree. observability: we need an exported CSV sample in the evidence bundle: timestamp, principal, action, resource, request-id, outcome.
jordan-eng: I'll add a small lambda to materialize that CSV into the S3 evidence prefix every 30m during the window.
sam-sre: re RBAC: vendor devs will be in `assessors` group. small checklist: 1) role created, 2) role trust policy to vendor account, 3) session duration=6h, 4) least-privilege policy attached.
maria-sec: tagging requirement: every role and bucket must have `pt:run=<vendor>` tag and `pt:window=2026-03-xx`. ops: enforce via policy.
pentest-assessor: can you confirm log sampling frequency? we need 1s granularity for flow logs and 1m for app logs ideally.
ordanote: (typo) jordan-eng: we can provide flow logs at 1s only for a subset of IP ranges due to cost. propose sampling on the target subnets.
olivia-gc: legal wants notice when any retained evidence is accessed after bundling. add `evidence-access` alert to secops.
maria-sec: secops, can you add that alert? @sam-sre please add a CloudWatch metric filter + sns.
sam-sre: will do. plan: create metric filter on proxy logs for `DECRYPT` + `SUCCESS` and publish to `pt-evidence-access` SNS.
jordan-eng: deployment plan: canary role first on Mon 14:00 PT then full cutover Mon 18:00 PT so vendor can smoke test Tue 08:30.
maria-sec: smoke test checklist: assume role, list S3 objects, fetch sample object, run decrypt via proxy, confirm audit entry.
pentest-assessor: we'll join smoke test. please drop vendor-assessor account id in this thread so we can whitelist.
maria-sec: vendor id = 981234567890. add to trust policy.
sam-sre: one more: evidence packaging script must include manifest.json with sha256sums and the CSV audit. I'll paste a tiny manifest example in the doc repo.
jordan-eng: docs: PR incoming to infra/docs/pt-runbook.md with commands and policies.
maria-sec: timeline recap: Mon 14:00 canary role, Mon 18:00 full role + proxy deployed to staging, Tue 08:30 vendor smoke, Tue 09:00-17:00 retest.
olivia-gc: confirm retention + legal mailbox for notifications: legal@redwood.ai.
devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra/roles/pentest-assessor -> Canary start 2026-03-16T21:00Z. CI job: infra-deploy-pt-role #432 queued.
sam-sre: I'll drop the IAM policy snippet here after lunch.
maria-sec: thanks all. final ask: anyone with objections to the KMS-proxy pattern speak now; otherwise we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
jordan-eng: :thumbsup:
pentest-assessor: :white_check_mark:
